title: stuck in the oven
body:

### Summary

Hi Streamlit team,
I deployed a Streamlit app on Streamlit Community Cloud, but it has been stuck on the “Your app is in the oven” page for a long time. The logs keep showing steps like “Provisioning machine”, “Preparing system…”, and “Spinning up manager…”, but the app never finishes starting.

I’m not sure if this is expected (slow provisioning) or if there’s an underlying error.
Could you please confirm whether this behavior indicates a problem, and what I should check or change?

Repo: https://github.com/camillechichet/kinetic-impact-calculator

App URL: https://kinetic-impact-calculator-camille.streamlit.app

Thank you!

Hi [USER] I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing this issue. It looks like the app is not shared publicly so I can't take a look personally. Are you able to confirm if you're still running into this issue?

I am experiencing the same issue with app [https://nychsfilter.streamlit.app/](url)  The app had been working earlier in the week. It went to sleep yesterday and I have been experiencing the issue since I first tried to wake it sometime yesterday.

I'm having the same issue with all of my Streamlit Cloud apps. The private app I'm primarily concerned about was fine until a few days ago. Here is an old public app that's having the same issue.

App: https://sixdegreesofcollegefootball.streamlit.app/
Repo: https://github.com/BenDavis71/SixDegreesOfCollegeFootball
Following advice on a related post, last night I changed the app settings to use Python 3.10 (it had been using Python 3.9). This resolved the issue.
Moving to Python 3.10 fixed my problems as well
Hello everyone affected — I reached out to the Cloud team, and the service has been restarted. Please let me know if you’re still seeing the issue.
